capability: Learn useful battle-attack choices from cartridge outcomes across distinct upstream Red-goal roots

method.source: Four authenticated red-battle-v2 source captures from four distinct upstream goal roots, split two train and two development before outcomes
method.assistance: Teacher-only in-memory insertion of Guillotine with five PP in physical move slot 4 of the active battler and party record before any input; not a final-player action
method.source_history_limit: The four upstream roots are historically existing captures, not newly earned full-player runs

train.pilot_fit: Frozen MLP representation, last layer only; 200 epochs, learning rate 0.01, prior L2 0.1, with explicit pilot minima two roots and one example per root below the ordinary four-by-four gate

development.pilot_vs_frozen: One better choice, one equivalent choice, zero worse choices
development.limitation: The pilot improves one choice but still misses that capture's best move; both models get only one of two best preferences. Two assisted development roots cannot establish generalizable superiority.

decision.red_checkpoint: 96/124 native-route registrations, 74 specimens, 198 cash; Model137 137 examples, 92 successes, 58 economy-qualified; fresh acceptance 0/5
decision.next: Stop this two-root pilot. Seek a broader, more natural choice-rich train curriculum meeting ordinary independent-root and per-lineage coverage, with separately reserved development roots. Require measured advantage over both frozen ranker and fixed heuristic before battle-authority promotion; otherwise reconsider the battle-learning representation.
